programme.desc: In Hasami, Nagasaki Prefecture, ceramics are made through a division of labor among local craftspeople. Yet she gradually finds herself drawn to the beauty of his creations.

programme.title: E1
programme.desc:
Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: E5 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: E8 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: E3 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. Moving the national animal of Bulgaria across international borders is something powers high up a

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 'The Carbon Pursuit of Happiness' is a major in-depth dialogue program on health and humanities presented by Phoenix TV this quarter, exploring the important role of 'carbon-based' in human life. 'The Carbon Pursuit of Happiness' transcends the existing framework of traditional health and wellness programs, combining carbon-based experiences with silicon-based data to explore the common interface between traditional Chinese and Western medicine in carbon-based health. Through 12 episodes of dialogue documentaries, combining authoritative global data, in-depth discussions, and clashes of viewpoints, it provides an accessible interpretation of 12 universal life questions.

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: E3
programme.desc: 《九霄寒夜暖》主要講述了機智女捕快蘇玖兒搭檔冷峻祺族少主寒猙探九霄迷案，展開一段甜蜜“溫差戀愛”的故事。 該劇講述了乾國“畏寒”女捕快蘇玖兒與祺族“內熱”少主寒猙因關乎兩族關係的離奇兇案相遇，機緣下組成“溫差搭檔”，攜手穿破陰謀迷霧，尋找案件背後真相的同時化解家國危機故事。

The Shadowless Tower
programme.desc: Gu Wentong, a middle-aged food critic, is drifting through the local eateries of vibrant Beijing with his younger photographer colleague Oyang. A divorce with a 6-year-old daughter and estranged from his father for decades, he is looking for a new perspective on life while reconsidering his failings as a father, a son, and a lover. While the seasons come and go, people get together and move apart. Only one thing will remain the same: The White Pagoda where they all meet sooner or later...

programme.title: Are You Lonesome Tonight?
programme.desc: On a dark night, Xueming hits a pedestrian with his car and flees the scene. Desperate to escape his feelings of guilt, he decides to approach the dead man's wife, Mrs Liang. Meanwhile, the body is discovered - riddled with bullets. Chen, the detective in charge of the investigation, becomes obsessed with the case. Years later, all three remain caught in a tangled web of memories and lies, desperately searching for a truth that refuses to be revealed...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E187 -Day Off
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Artisan spirit in films: DAY OFF
programme.desc: For forty years A-Rui has been running a barbershop, a small place where she has seen happiness and sorrow, ebb and flow. Faced with all the troubles in her life, A-Rui fully commits to her work and defeat is never an option for her, but her children never appreciate it and treat her profession with disdain. One day, A-Rui receives a phone call from the family of an old regular client who moved far away a long time ago. The family asks A-Rui if she would be willing to travel to cut the hair for the bedridden old man. Reminded of what her master taught her, “Always provide your best service,” A-Rui decides to hang up the “Day Off” sign and closes her shop for one day. She drives her beat-up old car and embarks on a long journey to do something others think is not worthwhile.

programme.title: The Rising Star -Renci Yeung
programme.desc: How did a late-night street shoot ignite Renci Yeung's dream of becoming an actress? Describing herself as a blend of conflicting rational and emotional sides, she found an outlet for her emotions through acting. How does she calmly face scrutiny and criticism from the public when taking on daring roles? Ten years into her career, this rising talent keeps cherishing every hard-won opportunity and moving forward with a free-spirited attitude and the same initial thrill for acting that first ignited her passion.

programme.title: My Daughter is a Zombie
programme.desc: Jung-hwan, a professional wild animal trainer, spends his days bickering and playing with his teenage daughter, Soo-ah, who is passionate about dancing. Then one day, Soo-ah gets infected by a zombie virus that sweeps across the world. To protect her, Jung-hwan takes Soo-ah to Eunbong-ri, a seaside village where his mother, Bam-soon, lives. In a society determined to root out the infected, Jung-hwan notices that Soo-ah still seems to understand words, responds to her favorite songs and dances, and even flinches when scolded by Grandma Bam-soon's back scratching stick. Refusing to give up on his daughter, Jung-hwan calls on his years of animal training experience and begins the top-secret mission of training his zombie daughter...

programme.title: E7
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: E18
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。
